method: Count each catalog archive and descriptor once as a distribution and each signed advertised ordinal once as an entry.

Read the original descriptor only after matching its catalog SHA-256. Ignore semicolon comments and trim ASCII keys and values. Report absent, empty and unsupported declarations independently of runtime behavior.

Count unique mine SHA-256 values across both inventories. Also count unique combinations of mine SHA-256, sibling archive or loose level SHA-256, descriptor SHA-256 and signed ordinal. An external addon or a different destination can still distinguish installations.
competitive_only_definition: Explicit normal=no and coop=no and at least one explicit yes among anarchy, robo_anarchy, capture_flag or hoard
